What is this? Send small attachments in JSON (_attachment).

When to use

Suitable ≤ ~10MB. Extension/MIME validation available.

How it works (analogy)

Sealed / locked envelopes plus one-time tickets protect this feature's requests.

Related API

buildFilePayload / verifyFilePayload

!
Warning

Also see Warnings. Defaults: replayTtl=120, clockSkew=60.

Technical details

Default protocol 4. Library v3.2.0. signAlg is server-controlled.
